access.notes: Installable via standard Linux package managers or from source; any open‑source planewave DFT code that supports PBE/PW91, PAW pseudopotentials, and slab boundary conditions may be used.
PAW pseudopotentials for Au, S, C, H with PBE or PW91 functional. Other reputable pseudopotential sets (e.g., pslibrary) are acceptable.
